Priya (Cust-Sec): For the POC we need concrete logging evidence: SIEM ingestion examples, immutable retention (WORM), admin audit samples (who changed model configs), and a tamper-evident export flow for e-discovery. Can you deliver before the review on Thursday?

Sam (SalesEng): Yes. We'll provide: sanitized admin JSONL, SIEM HEC + Filebeat snippets, S3 Object Lock example, export manifest with SHA256 + KMS sig, and a tiny verify script.

Maya (Solutions): Sample admin line (redacted): {"ts":"2026-03-22T11:04:00Z","actor":"***@redacted","action":"model.pin","target":"model:psi-4b","req_id":"r_123"}

Maya (Solutions): S3 Object Lock example we'll include. We'll also add HMAC-chain example for audit entries and a verify_export.py that checks file hashes + manifest signature offline.

redwood-deploy-bot: export started job=exp_20260322_11 status=running

Priya (Cust-Sec): Need confirmation that manifest contains KMS key ARN and export_id recorded in the append-only audit stream.

Sam (SalesEng): Confirmed. Manifest includes kms_key_arn and export_id; audit stream stores the export event with HMAC chain. We'll post links to sanitized bundle when job completes.

redwood-deploy-bot: export completed job=exp_20260322_11 status=completed url=https://s3.redwood/exports/exp_20260322_11.tar.gz

Priya (Cust-Sec): Great — we'll review and get back by Friday. Thanks.
